input.message:
I mapped the payment code paths in /tank/nxeon-wt-signupfix (branch `feature/signup-fixes-activity`, clean tree). All paths below are relative to that root.

Three things you'd otherwise trip on:
- **The "wallet-only" comments are stale.** Comments in `lib/local-payment-methods.ts` and `components/customer/AddFunds.tsx` say local methods are wallet top-up only. In fact the deploy wizard can also pay orders with them (§6).
- **The deploy wizard never looks at the customer's country.** Local methods depend only on the merchant settings (§6).
- **Disputes have no code path at all.** There is no handler and no webhook case (§5).

## 1. Stripe webhook — `app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` (`POST`, 97 lines)
- **Signature:** reads the `stripe-signature` header and the raw body (`req.text()`). Line 19: `stripe().webhooks.constructEvent(raw, sig, process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)`. Returns 400 if it isn't configured, the header is missing, or the signature is invalid.
- **Handled events** (if-statements, not a switch):
  - L30 `checkout.session.completed` and `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded` → `fulfilCheckoutSession(session.id)` (`lib/fulfil-checkout.ts`). Errors are logged and swallowed.
  - L59 `checkout.session.expired` and `checkout.session.async_payment_failed` → `releaseReservation(metadata.nxeonPromoReservation)` from `lib/promo-redemption.ts`, and `releaseOrderCouponReservation(metadata.nxeonCouponReservation)` from `lib/coupon-redemption.ts`.
  - L87 `payment_intent.payment_failed` → `handleFailedPaymentIntent(pi)` in `lib/payment-failed-recovery.ts:25`.
    - It only acts when `last_payment_error.code === "payment_intent_authentication_failure"`.
    - It finds the session via `checkout.sessions.list({payment_intent})` and makes a retry link with `createHostedFallbackFromSession`.
    - It emails `emails.checkoutPaymentRetry`, deduped on `EmailLog.template = "checkout_payment_retry:<pi.id>"`.
  - Always returns `200 {received:true}`.
- **No event-level dedupe.** There is no StripeEvent table and `event.id` is never stored. Idempotency is per session:
  - `FulfilledSession.stripeSessionId @unique`: `claim()` at `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts:68` creates the row (P2002 means already claimed); `settle()` at L78 sets DONE/FAILED plus detail.
  - `WalletTransaction.stripeSessionId @unique`, used by `creditCheckoutSession` at `lib/stripe.ts:1524`.
- **Per-event fulfilment:** `fulfilCheckoutSession` (L183) → `retrieveCheckoutSession` → `classifyCheckoutSession` (`lib/stripe.ts:1249`) → `runFulfilment` (L211):
  - `unpaid`: no-op. A local-pay session redirects to `?pending=1`.
  - Otherwise it calls `creditCheckoutSession`. That runs one transaction: WalletTransaction "Stripe payment (cs_…)" + `balanceCents` increment + Notification, plus a PAID "Wallet top-up" Invoice when it isn't a purchase leg. After that: `maybeRewardReferral`, and the receipt email for top-ups only.
  - Then it dispatches by `purpose.kind`:
    - `unreadable` (L254)
    - `order` → `placeOrder` (L267)
    - `gameOrder` (L338)
    - `hostOrder` (L382)
    - `emailOrder` (L427)
    - `domainOrder` (L463)
    - `resize` (L514)
    - `diskExpand` (L548)
    - `dedicatedIp` (L581)
    - `topup` (L612–627)
  - Each branch runs claim → place → settle(DONE) → `saveCardFromPaymentSession` → `reportPurchase` (Meta CAPI + Google Ads). On failure it runs settle(FAILED) + `notifyStalled`, and for VPS also `recordDeployFunnelError`.
- **Success redirect:** `app/api/stripe/confirm/route.ts` `GET ?session_id=` calls the same `fulfilCheckoutSession(sessionId, base)` and redirects to its result. It is unauthenticated.
- The admin page `app/admin/billing/page.tsx:197` only tells the owner to enable `checkout.session.completed`.

## 2. Checkout Session creation (every `checkout.sessions.create`)
**Common to all of them:** `mode:"payment"`; currency is hard-coded `"usd"` except the local-method sessions. Every session sets `metadata.nxeonUserId`.

**Return URL and cancel handling:** almost every session returns to `return_url = ${APP_URL}/api/stripe/confirm?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`.
- Only two sessions set a `cancel_url` (both hosted): `createHostedFallbackFromSession` → `/dashboard/deploy`, and `createOutstandingCheckout` → `/dashboard/servers/<id>`.
- **No route handles the cancel return.** Those are plain dashboard pages. Embedded/elements sessions have no cancel URL; closing the modal is the cancel.
- Abandonment shows up only through the `checkout.session.expired` webhook.

### lib/stripe.ts — Custom Checkout sessions (live paths)
These use `ui_mode:"elements"`, `payment_method_types:["card"]`, `setup_future_usage:"off_session"`, `saved_payment_method_options:{payment_method_save:"enabled"}`, and `expires_at` = now + 1 h (`ORDER_CHECKOUT_EXPIRES_MS`).

| Function (line) | Caller | Metadata keys |
|---|---|---|
| `createOrderPaymentSession` (716) | `lib/actions.ts:751` (VPS `payAndDeploy`) | `nxeonOrder`, `nxeonOrderPrice`, `nxeonPromoCampaign`, optional `nxeonPromoReservation` / `nxeonCouponReservation` |
| `createGameOrderPaymentSession` (774) | `lib/actions-gameplans.ts:364` | `nxeonGameOrder`, `nxeonGameOrderPrice`, optional `nxeonGameConfig`, optional `nxeonCouponReservation` |
| `createHostingOrderPaymentSession` (853) | `lib/actions-hosting.ts:588` | `nxeonHostOrder` |
| `createEmailOrderPaymentSession` (898) | `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts:326` | `nxeonEmailOrder` |
| `createDomainOrderPaymentSession` (968) | `lib/actions-domains.ts:571` | `nxeonDomainOrder` `{domainOrderId}`, `nxeonDomainOrderPrice` |
| `createTopUpPaymentSession` (1024) | `app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts:88` (wallet top-up; route enforces `min_topup_cents` and a $5000 max) | `nxeonUserId` only |

### lib/stripe.ts — embedded sessions
These use `ui_mode:"embedded_page"` with `EMBEDDED_REQUEST_OPTS`, `setup_future_usage:"off_session"`, and no `payment_method_types` (so Stripe's defaults apply).
- `createDedicatedIpCheckout` (372), called from `lib/actions-dedicated-ip.ts:75`. Metadata `nxeonDedicatedIp {serverId, chargeCents}`.
- `createResizeCheckout` (430), called from `lib/actions-server.ts:204`. Metadata `nxeonResize {serverId, planId, chargeCents}`.
- `createDiskExpandCheckout` (485), called from `lib/actions-disk.ts:101`. Metadata `nxeonDiskExpand {serverId, addGB, chargeCents}`.
- None of these three sets `expires_at`.
- Apparently unused (no callers outside tests): `createOrderCheckout` (182), `createGameOrderCheckout` (285), `createHostingOrderCheckout` (570), `createEmailOrderCheckout` (621).

### Hosted fallback
`createHostedFallbackFromSession` (135) copies the original session's line items and metadata into a hosted session, keeping the original currency, with `success_url` = the confirm route. Callers: `lib/actions-payment-fallback.ts:34` (`getHostedCheckoutFallback`) and `lib/payment-failed-recovery.ts:69`.

### Local methods (§6)
- `createLocalTopUpPaymentSession` (1081): `payment_method_types:[m.stripeType]`, currency `m.chargeCurrency`, no `setup_future_usage`. Metadata `nxeonUserId`, `nxeonLocalPay`, `nxeonCreditUsdCents`. Called from `app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts:70` when `method !== "card"`.
- `createLocalOrderPaymentSession` (1130): body built by `buildLocalOrderSession` (`lib/local-order-payment.ts`). Metadata is the order keys plus `nxeonLocalPay` + `nxeonCreditUsdCents`. Called from `lib/actions-payment-providers.ts:727` (`openLocalOrderPayment`), which is reached through `createOrder|GameOrder|HostingOrder|EmailOrderLocalPayment` (743/752/761/770) via `lib/nx/local-order.ts` `openWizardLocalPayment`.

### lib/stripe-cards.ts
- `createCardSetupSession` (191): `mode:"setup"`, elements, card only, metadata `nxeonCardSetup:"1"`. `return_url` is `<returnPath>?card_setup={id}`. Callers: `lib/actions-payment-method.ts:58` (`startCardSetup`) and `lib/actions-hosting.ts:882`.
- `createOutstandingCheckout` (1035): hosted session for a 3DS renewal, metadata `nxeonUserId` only (classifies as a top-up). `success_url` is the confirm route; `cancel_url` is `/dashboard/servers/<id>`. Called from `worker/billing.ts:1305`.
- `createOutstandingEmbedded` (1109): elements version of the above. Called from `lib/actions-payment-method.ts:184` (`settleOutstanding`).

## 3. Off-session charges
- **Core function:** `chargeSavedCardOffSession` (`lib/stripe-cards.ts:843`).
  - Guard 1: `findChargeByMarker` (L809) lists the customer's PaymentIntents (limit 100) and matches `metadata.nxeonChargeKey` against the marker. Markers come from `renewalChargeMarker` (L799, `renew:<serverId>:<iso>`) or `autoRechargeMarker` (L804).
  - Then at L903: `paymentIntents.create({amount, currency:"usd", customer, payment_method, confirm:true, off_session:true, automatic_payment_methods:{enabled:true, allow_redirects:"never"}, metadata:{…, nxeonUserId, nxeonChargeKey}}, {idempotencyKey})`.
  - Returns an `OffSessionResult`.
- **Failure classification:** `classifyChargeError` (`lib/stripe-charge-errors.ts:101`). It does not use `instanceof StripeCardError`; it duck-types the error with `asStripeError` (needs `rawType` set or `type` starting with "Stripe"):
  - `code==="authentication_required"` or `payment_intent.status==="requires_action"` → `requires_action`
  - `rawType==="card_error"` → `declined`, with `code: decline_code ?? code`
  - `invalid_request_error` + `resource_missing` → `unavailable` / `missing_at_stripe`
  - message matches `NOT_REUSABLE_RE` → `unavailable` / `not_reusable`
  - anything else → `transient`
- **Ledger credit:** `creditOffSessionCharge` (`lib/stripe-cards.ts:972`) writes the WalletTransaction (`stripePaymentIntentId @unique`) + balance increment + an optional PAID invoice.
- **VPS renewal sweep:** `billingSweep` (`worker/billing.ts:238`) runs every 10 min from `worker/index.ts:3273`, alongside `productRenewalSweep`. Path: `renewDueServer` (382) → `attemptCardRenewal` (1171).
  - Charge at L1188 with idempotency key `nxeon_renew_<id>_<ts>_a<stage>_<cents>`.
  - Success → `creditOffSessionCharge` + `commitRenewal` (867; writes the WalletTransaction debit, Invoice and `auditLog billing.renewed` at L1053) + receipt email.
  - `transient` → `rescheduleAttempt`.
  - `unavailable` → `retireUnusableCard` (625).
  - `requires_action` → `createOutstandingCheckout` + `dunningPayUrl` + email.
  - `declined` → `recordDeclinedAttempt` (1470).
  - PayPal variant: `attemptPayPalRenewal` (1370) → `chargeVaultedPayPalOffSession` (`lib/paypal.ts:340`).
- **Auto-recharge:** `autoRechargeSweep` (`worker/billing.ts:1795`), charge at L1819 with key `nxeon_autorecharge_<uid>_<day>_<amt>`.
- **Hosting renewals:** `worker/product-renewals.ts:451` `topUpHostingFromCard`, charge at L465. Any failure just falls through to the grace period.
- **Admin "Renew now":** `adminRenewServerNow` (`lib/actions.ts:1427`) → `renewServerImmediately` (`worker/billing.ts:724`) → wallet `commitRenewal` or `attemptCardRenewal`. It audits `admin.renew_now` through `recordAudit` on both success and failure.
- **Customer `renewNow`** (`lib/actions.ts:995`) is wallet-only.
- **Paying an outstanding renewal with a saved card:** `settleOutstanding` (`lib/actions-payment-method.ts:130`) opens an embedded session rather than charging off-session. `retryDunningNow` is at `lib/stripe-cards.ts:765`.

## 4. PayPal and Coinbase
- **`lib/paypal.ts`:**
  - `createPayPalOrder` (202): POST `/v2/checkout/orders`, intent CAPTURE, `custom_id = pendingId`, return/cancel URL `/dashboard/deploy`, `vault:true` with a retry without vault.
  - `capturePayPalOrder` (247), `getPayPalOrder` (278), `vaultInfoFromCapture` (291), `chargeVaultedPayPalOffSession` (340), `verifyPayPalWebhookSignature` (414, calls PayPal's `/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature`).
- **`lib/actions-payment-providers.ts`:**
  - `openPayPal` (107) creates a `PendingExternalPayment` row, then calls `createPayPalOrder`.
  - `captureExternalPayPalOrder` (199) checks status COMPLETED and that the amount matches, saves the vault id, then calls `fulfilExternalPayment`.
  - Public create actions: `createOrderPayPalOrder` (373), `createGameOrderPayPalOrder` (489), `createHostingOrderPayPalOrder` (577), `createEmailOrderPayPalOrder` (654).
  - Coinbase equivalents: `openCoinbase` (147), `create*CoinbaseCharge` (388/496/584/661).
- **PayPal webhook:** `app/api/paypal/webhook/route.ts` handles only `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED`. It gets the order id from `resource.supplementary_data.related_ids.order_id`, calls `getPayPalOrder`, reads `custom_id` as the pending id, saves the vault, then calls `fulfilExternalPayment`.
- **Coinbase webhook:** `app/api/coinbase/webhook/route.ts` checks header `x-cc-webhook-signature` with `verifyCoinbaseWebhookSignature`, handles only `charge:confirmed`, then calls `fulfilExternalPayment`.
- **`fulfilExternalPayment`** (`lib/fulfil-checkout.ts:755`) builds a synthetic session with id `paypal:<orderId>` or `coinbase:<code>` and runs `runFulfilment`. Crediting goes through `creditExternalPayment` (L662), labelled "PayPal payment (…)" or "Coinbase Commerce payment (…)" and keyed on the same `stripeSessionId` unique column. It sets `PendingExternalPayment.status` to PAID or FAILED.

## 5. Wallet, refunds, disputes, dunning
- **Wallet ledger:** model `WalletTransaction`, plus `User.balanceCents`.
  - Credits: `creditCheckoutSession` (`lib/stripe.ts:1524`), `creditExternalPayment`, `creditOffSessionCharge`.
  - Debits: `debitWallet(tx, userId, cents)` (`lib/wallet.ts:16`, a conditional `updateMany`). Debit rows are written in `placeOrder` / `commitRenewal` etc.
  - Manual adjustments: `adjustBalance` (`lib/actions-admin-billing.ts:284`).
- **Refunds:** the only `stripe.refunds.create` call is in `refundPayment` (`lib/actions-admin-billing.ts:56`), at L142.
  - It finds the Stripe session from a WalletTransaction description containing "Stripe payment (cs_", gets the PaymentIntent, and calls `refunds.create({payment_intent, amount}, {idempotencyKey: refund:<invoiceId>:<pi>:<alreadyRefunded>:<cents>})`. If that fails it falls back to a wallet-only refund.
  - It then does a compare-and-swap on `Invoice.refundedCents` (setting `REFUNDED` when full), debits the wallet, writes a "Refund — …" ledger row and an optional "Write-off" row, reverses partner commission, and writes `auditLog billing.refund`.
  - PayPal and Coinbase money is never refunded to the provider.
- **Disputes:** no Stripe dispute webhook or handler (`app/admin/insights/tabs/payments.tsx:30` and `lib/insights/growth.ts:10` confirm this). The only related code is the admin's manual `adminReverseCommissionForChargeback` (`lib/actions-partner.ts` ~L309), audited as `partner.chargeback`.
- **Dunning** (all in `worker/billing.ts`):
  - `recordDeclinedAttempt` (1470): updates `Server.dunningStage` / `dunningNextAt`, writes `auditLog billing.card_declined` (L1540), sends email and notification.
  - `nudgeCardReadd` (524) / `sendCardReaddNotice` (555): `billing.card_readd_notice`.
  - `retireUnusableCard` (625): `billing.card_unusable_grace`.
  - `suspendUnpaid` (1680): `billing.suspended_unpaid`.
  - `terminateOverdue`: `billing.terminated_unpaid` (L2279).
  - Config comes from `lib/dunning-config.ts` `dunningConfig()`. `lib/dunning-schedule.ts` is a pure portal-side copy of the timing math (`dunningView`, `withBillingGrace`).
  - Also: `cardHealthSweep` in `worker/card-health.ts`; `markPaymentMethodUnusable` / `forgetMissingPaymentMethod` in `lib/stripe-cards.ts` (audit `card.*`).
  - Product renewals: `worker/product-renewals.ts` writes `billing.renewed` and `billing.suspended_unpaid`.

## 6. Local payment methods
- **Method table:** `lib/local-payment-methods.ts` `LOCAL_METHODS`:

| Method | Charge currency | Merchant-entity countries | Customer countries |
|---|---|---|---|
| paynow | SGD | SG | SG |
| grabpay | SGD | SG | SG, MY |
| upi | INR | SG, CA | IN |
| alipay | USD | CA | CN, HK, MY, SG |
| wechat_pay | USD | CA | CN, HK, SG |

  - **Not implemented anywhere:** bKash, QRIS, FPX, GCash, PromptPay (the comments at L23–24 say so explicitly).
- **When a method is on:** `lib/local-payments.ts` `enabledLocalMethods()` requires all of:
  - Stripe is configured
  - setting `pay_method_<id>` is true (default `"false"`, `lib/settings.ts:379-383`)
  - `stripe_account_country` is in `entityCountries` (default `""`, L387)
  - it can be priced: SGD/INR need a rate in `local_pay_fx_rates` (default `"{}"`); buffer `local_pay_fx_buffer_pct` defaults to 2
- **Pricing:** the customer is charged `localChargeCents`, i.e. ceil(usd × rate × (1+buffer)). The wallet is credited `walletCreditCents` (L159), the USD amount from `nxeonCreditUsdCents`.
- **Country filtering:** `localMethodsForCountry(cc)` (L62) filters by `customerCountries`, but it is only used by `localPayCardHtml` on the marketing landing pages (`app/nxm/_data/location-landing.ts:467`).
- **Per-country answer:**
  - **With default settings:** nothing is offered anywhere, for any country.
  - **Landing-page text** (if enabled): IN → UPI (INR, needs an SG or CA entity plus an INR rate). SG → PayNow and GrabPay (SGD, SG entity plus an SGD rate), or Alipay / WeChat Pay (USD) with a CA entity. ID and BD → nothing.
  - **Actual checkout:** neither the Add-funds picker (`/api/stripe/local-methods` → `enabledLocalMethods`) nor the deploy wizard filters by customer country. Every enabled method is shown to every customer: an Indian user would see PayNow/GrabPay, and an ID or BD user would see whatever is enabled.
- **Deploy-wizard Payment step:** yes, it shows them.
  - The live wizard is `components/nx/DeployView.tsx` (`PaymentSlide`, L557). `app/dashboard/deploy/DeployPageContent.tsx:74-77` passes `enabledLocalMethods()` in (empty for guests).
  - Tiles are added at L839 as `local:<id>` when `methods.card && isLocalOrderService(service)`, i.e. VPS, game, hosting and email; not domains.
  - The session opens through `openWizardLocalPayment` (L874), and `NxLocalPayFields` renders the form.
  - The older `components/customer/PaymentStep.tsx` uses card only.

## 7. Prisma models (`prisma/schema.prisma`)
- **There is no Payment, Transaction or StripeEvent model.**
- `WalletTransaction` (1255): `id`, `userId`, `amountCents` (±), `description`, `stripeSessionId @unique?`, `stripePaymentIntentId @unique?`, `createdAt`.
- `FulfilledSession` (2936): `stripeSessionId @unique` (also holds `paypal:` / `coinbase:` ids), `kind`, `status` CLAIMED|DONE|FAILED, `detail`, timestamps.
- `PendingExternalPayment` (3021): `provider` paypal|coinbase, `kind`, `userId`, `amountCents`, `currency`, `metadata` (JSON string), `providerRef`, `status` PENDING|PAID|FAILED|EXPIRED.
- `Invoice` (1726): `number` (autoincrement), `userId`, `amountCents`, `taxCents`, `taxRatePercent`, `taxCountry`, `status` (enum OPEN|PAID|VOID|REFUNDED), `refundedCents`, `description`, `lineItems` Json, `periodStart`/`periodEnd`, `paidAt`, `paidBrand`/`paidLast4`, `dedicatedIpCents`, `partnerCommissions`.
- `PaymentCard` (350): `stripePaymentMethodId @unique`, `brand`, `last4`, `exp*`, `isPrimary`, `unusableAt`, `unusableReason`.
